episode_lines.about: One spoiler-free line per chapter, put in front of the owner's episode template: where we are and whose story it is, no outcomes. Draft wording by the coding agent (from the checked summary), approved for publication by the owner, FID 6786, on 2026-10-10 ("Go ahead. And publish"); the owner may rewrite any of them.

lines.1: In Meldan, the capital of Veridia, Gladias goes to judge a concert for the Order of Steering.
lines.2: In Pafogai Du, in Dzego, two students, Fin and Zei, walk to a physics class.
lines.3: Gladias goes to meet the stranger who sent him an anonymous message.
lines.4: In Dzego, Zei prepares for the quarter final of the Minpentai championship.
lines.5: Zei, his mother and Bai travel to Freetown, in the United Cities.
lines.6: Gladias talks with his friend Mov, and goes to a citizens' assembly.
lines.7: In Dzego, Zei faces Bai in the city's Minpentai final.
lines.8: In Meldan, Gladias goes before the senators who decide whether he joins the Order.
lines.9: In Dzego, Bai talks with Fin, and Zei makes his way deep inside the mountain pyramid.
lines.10: In Freetown, Meldan and Pafogai Du, three conversations about the Arctic threat.
lines.11: In Meldan, Gladias watches Zven play Helisport, and joins a Keeper group on air quality.
lines.12: Zei arrives in Sadzu Du, Dzego's capital, for the national championship.
lines.13: Gladias meets Delwart again, and Mov has news about him.
lines.14: In Sadzu Du, Zei plays his semi final, and has tea with a new friend.
lines.15: News from Redshire reaches Freetown, Meldan and Dzego.
lines.17: Gladias visits the parliament, and the Keepers vote.
lines.18: Gladias arrives in Dzego, and meets Zei, Bai and Fin.
lines.19: Deep in the mountain pyramid, Zei receives a strange message.
lines.20: In Meldan, Seila wakes to an alarm, and goes looking for answers.
lines.21: Seila's family gathers for dinner, and she calls Gladias.
lines.22: In Freetown, Jahn sees the city preparing, and Zei shows him something remarkable.
lines.23: In Dzego, the friends plan their next steps, and a call comes from home.
lines.24: Gladias, unable to sleep, turns to Bai, and then to Den with an unusual idea.
lines.25: Zei teaches Gladias an old game, and they call Senator Verdow.
lines.26: The friends fly to Veridia, and the Kungaupei attempt a daring rescue.
lines.27: Seila has a new idea, and the friends meet Silverchat's founder.
lines.28: A general comes to talk, and there is news about Lily.
lines.29: On a snowy hill in Elenar Forest, the battle for Northshore begins.
lines.30: The battle for Northshore goes on through the night.
lines.31: On a mountain above Northglade, old friends meet again.
lines.32: Back in Meldan, Gladias and Seila walk to the parliament to talk about what comes next.
